{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display basic info
print("First few rows:")
print(trial.head())

print("\nData types and missing values:")
print(trial.info())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(trial.isnull().sum())

# Check gender distribution
gender_dist = trial['gender'].value_counts()
print("\nGender distribution:")
print(gender_dist)

# Check treatment arm distribution
treatment_dist = trial['treatment_arm'].value_counts()
print("\nTreatment arm distribution:")
print(treatment_dist)

# Check if response variable exists
print("\nColumns:")
print(trial.columns)"}
